meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总指定时间内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要整理多场会议纪要并形成周报
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes from a date range into structured reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into weekly reports

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按指定时间范围查找会议，取回对应的纪要信息并整理成结构化报告（单日或周报），也可按需生成在线文档。
howto.when: 当用户提出整理会议纪要、生成会议周报或回顾一段时间内会议内容等请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 生成这周的会议纪要周报。
汇总最近一段时间的会议并输出报告。

say.text: 回顾过去一周开了哪些会
say.note: 列出过去一周的会议清单概览。

howto.what_en: Claude finds meetings in the given time range, retrieves their note info, and compiles a structured report (daily or weekly). It can also create an online document on request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to organize meeting notes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review meetings from a time period.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting notes

say_en.note: Aggregates meetings and outputs a report.

say_en.text: Review which meetings were held last week
